details:
=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- scripts/ai_memory_lib.py:3040-3052, 3077-3084, 3090 | severity=critical | confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3, moonshotai_kimi-k3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus]
  PROBLEM: `_resolve_origin_url` embeds `GH_TOKEN` in HTTPS clone URLs, exposing credentials through subprocess arguments, Git diagnostics, exceptions, and persisted remotes.
  WHY: The previous ephemeral `http.extraHeader` authentication was removed; every memory clone/fetch/push using the token can leak it.
- scripts/ai_memory_lib.py:_inject_token_into_url (lines 3040-3052) and _resolve_origin_url (lines 3077-3084) | severity=critical | confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [moonshotai_kimi-k3]
  PROBLEM: The prior `GH_PAT`-or-`GH_TOKEN` authentication fallback was replaced with `GH_TOKEN` only.
  WHY: Environments exporting `GH_PAT` without `GH_TOKEN` now perform unauthenticated memory operations and can fail.
- scripts/memory_helpers.sh:569-595, 597-630, 130-185, 767, 883-922 | severity=critical | confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3, moonshotai_kimi-k3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus]
  PROBLEM: `_memory_force_tick_remote_url` embeds credentials in remote URLs and `memory_ensure_branch` plus force-tick operations use raw unauthenticated Git commands after `_memory_git` was removed.
  WHY: Token-bearing URLs leak credentials, while `persist-credentials: false` makes raw `git ls-remote` and `git push` fail and silently degrade memory initialization and force-tick operations.
- scripts/targeted_file_context.py:152-169, 241-247, 568-580 | severity=critical | confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3, moonshotai_kimi-k3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus]
  PROBLEM: The sensitive-path guard was deleted, allowing untrusted target paths such as `.git/config`, `.env*`, `.ssh/`, and credential files to be resolved and read into model-visible context.
  WHY: Crafted plan, issue, or PR-derived paths can expose repository secrets and metadata; the existing contract tests also depend on the removed guard.
- scripts/write_codex_config.sh:99-148, 258-264 | severity=critical | confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3, moonshotai_kimi-k3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus]
  PROBLEM: `--provider-base-url` and its validation were removed while production callers still pass the option.
  WHY: The script exits with `unknown argument: --provider-base-url` before Codex starts, breaking broker-prepared Codex phases.
- scripts/write_codex_config.sh:258-264 | severity=critical | confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3, moonshotai_kimi-k3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus]
  PROBLEM: The generated Codex configuration hard-codes `base_url = "https://openrouter.ai/api/v1"` instead of using the broker loopback URL.
  WHY: If parser failure is bypassed, Codex connects directly to OpenRouter and bypasses broker model authorization, token-budget, request, and cost controls.
- scripts/gh_helpers.sh:493-498, 974-1377 | severity=critical | confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3, moonshotai_kimi-k3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus]
  PROBLEM: `git_with_github_auth` and the `review_blocked_*` human-approval helper family were deleted while in-tree callers remain.
  WHY: Review-blocked terminal actions cannot post or verify human approval, successor issues cannot be actuated, and the review-blocked workflow can remain unresolved or fail with missing-command errors.
- scripts/review_rb_judge.sh:2014 | severity=critical | confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3, moonshotai_kimi-k3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus]
  PROBLEM: The judge-fix push path calls deleted `git_with_github_auth` without a guard.
  WHY: The `[judge-fix]` commit push fails with `command not found`, so fixes never reach the PR branch.
- scripts/gh_helpers.sh:735-769, 833-840, 913-922 | severity=high | confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3, moonshotai_kimi-k3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus]
  PROBLEM: REST and GraphQL comment projections dropped `id`, `author_id`, `author_type`, and `author_association`.
  WHY: Poller and judge consumers cannot authenticate producer-signed markers, deduplicate comments, or reliably detect review-blocked approval/refusal state.
- tests/test_targeted_file_context.py:30, 37, 714-781 | severity=critical | confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus]
  PROBLEM: The test module imports `MAX_TARGET_PATHS` and `is_sensitive_target_path`, which no longer exist.
  WHY: `python3 -m pytest tests/test_targeted_file_context.py` fails at module import before any tests run.
- scripts/targeted_file_context.py:558-564 | severity=high | confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3, moonshotai_kimi-k3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus]
  PROBLEM: `emit_context` returns a header and disabled marker when `max_bytes <= 0` instead of the documented empty string.
  WHY: Callers cannot produce an empty targeted-context block, prompt budget is consumed, and existing zero-budget contract tests fail.
- scripts/targeted_file_context.py:152-156, 568-716 | severity=critical | confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3, moonshotai_kimi-k3]
  PROBLEM: `MAX_TARGET_PATHS`, `MAX_TARGET_PATH_BYTES`, and output budget accounting were removed, leaving path iteration and marker/header output unbounded.
  WHY: Large untrusted path lists can cause unbounded filesystem work and produce output beyond `TARGETED_FILE_CONTEXT_MAX_BYTES`, potentially exceeding Codex input limits.
- scripts/implement_commit_changes.sh:59-67, 62-68 | severity=high | confidence=[4]
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3, moonshotai_kimi-k3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus]
  PROBLEM: Cleanup changed from staged-and-worktree restoration to worktree-only restoration for `pre_assembled_static.txt`.
  WHY: Staged modifications or deletions can remain in the index and leak into the implementation commit.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:8440-8475 | severity=high | confidence=[4]
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: A failed paginated comment fetch or invalid `select-resolver-retry` payload returns success without preserving the previous resolver retry state.
  WHY: Transient API failures can drop the escalation state and redispatch a resolver, defeating the lifetime circuit breaker.
- scripts/review_conflict_actuate.sh:39-83 | severity=high | confidence=[4]
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: A failed paginated comment fetch can be treated as an empty comment set and cause a fresh retry-state marker to be posted.
  WHY: API outages can create duplicate retry-state comments and pollute highest-generation selection.
- .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml:896-920, 1050-1080 | severity=low | confidence=[3]
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro]
  PROBLEM: `actions/checkout@v5` and `actions/setup-python@v5` remain mutable references in post-merge jobs.
  WHY: A compromised mutable action tag could execute with `GH_PAT` and `GH_TOKEN`, retaining the supply-chain risk addressed elsewhere.

=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
